Monospaced candidates

Identical code and prose at the same size. Compare density, punctuation, and ambiguous glyphs.

Source Code ProNoto Sans MonoFira Code

The Shape of Reading

A precise working voice for code and data.

Every character occupies one dependable measure, keeping examples, columns, and indentation aligned.

AMBIGUOUS FORMSIl1| · O0Q · rn m · {}[]() · <=>

fn compose(page: &Page) {
    let rhythm = page.baseline();
    assert!(rhythm.is_steady());
}
